text: {"name":"ble_conn_rf_configure","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Applies per-link RF register and limit updates for the indexed BLE connection, then returns its LL connection-state object by handle.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"conn_index","a2":"limit","v2":"conn_table","v4":"conn_entry","v6":"link_index","v16":"conn_entry_bytes","v17":"effective_limit","v18":"conn_handle","v19":"link_limit","v21":"rf_config"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Connection-entry control flags; bits 0x20 and 0x04 select separate RF handling paths."},{"offset":34,"meaning":"Link index used to access per-link configuration."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"BLE connection handle passed to the LL connection-state lookup."},{"offset":308,"meaning":"Per-connection limit input, normalized and capped before use."},{"offset":309,"meaning":"Effective per-connection limit after applying the supplied and per-link caps."},{"offset":350,"meaning":"Connection-entry status flags; bit 3 is set before returning."}]}
